treatstream.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to TreatStream right now.

treatstream.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a TreatStream treat inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to TreatStream and it works without a connection.

parameters.kind: Optional. Which event. Only "treat" exists, and it is the default.

treatstream.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test treat was sent, false when the kind is unknown.
